programme.title: LIVEFEED
programme.desc: Nestled in the heart of Oxbury, Ontario, the Giant Pig Smokehouse opened in 2019, bringing Southern barbecue to life. The journey began in 2018 on Melissa's 30th birthday during a trip to Mexico when her brother proposed the idea of opening a restaurant. Embracing their love for smoked foods and recognizing the local events like Vankleek Hill Fair and Rib Fests, they decided to share their culinary passion beyond their home. The Giant Pig Smokehouse offers a variety of Southern barbecue dishes, with pulled pork poutine and brisket poutine being top sellers. Their pulled pork is described as sweet, saucy, and flavorful, often served in sandwiches or on poutines. The authenticity of their poutin gravy, made with meat drippings, is a highlight for many patrons. Customers praise the establishment for its delicious food and the welcoming atmosphere. Bianca from Gatineau, who tried the brisket poutine, found it amazing and fulfilling. McKenna and Matt from Alberta and Stoweville, Ontario, also shared their positive experiences, highlighting the quality of the barbecue and the friendly service. The owners emphasize the importance of patience in barbecue, advocating for slow cooking and marination to achieve the best flavors. They share their journey from backyard barbecues to a full-fledged restaurant, driven by their love for barbecue and the joy of sharing their creations with others. Working with family has its challenges and rewards. While the bond and trust are invaluable, there are moments of bickering that can be mistaken for conflict by customers. Despite these moments, the family's dedication to their craft and to each other shines through. The Giant Pig Smokehouse is not just a restaurant; it's a family business where love and dedication are infused into every dish. The secret to their success lies in the love and flavor they put into their food, ensuring every meal is as cherished as if it were served to their own family.

programme.title: The Luxury Travel Show S1 - "Ulagala, Sri Lanka - Florence"
programme.desc: From Michael Angelo\u2019s David in Florence to elephant safaris in Sri Lanka, this is an art lovers and outdoorsy adventure.

programme.title: The Luxury Travel Show S1 - "Algarve & Parrot Cay (Turks & Caicos Islands)"
programme.desc: From miles of soft golden sand in Portugal\u2019s Algarve region, to the miles of sand that surrounds Parrot Cay Island in the Turks and Caicos, this is a beach lover\u2019s episode.

programme.title: Weekend Breaks with Gregg Wallace S1 - "Vienna"
programme.desc: Gregg Wallace heads to the home of the Christmas market, Vienna, to get to the bottom of what makes them so special, checking out great festive food, fascinating traditions and warming drinks!

programme.title: Weekend Breaks with Gregg Wallace S1 - "Rome"
programme.desc: Gregg Wallace heads to the Italian Capital, Rome, for a Weekend Break. Over the course of 3 days he eats amazing local dishes, tours the sights \u2013 both by foot and by scooter - and even tries his hand as a Gladiator.

programme.title: Weekend Breaks with Gregg Wallace S1 - "Barcelona"
programme.desc: Gregg Wallace heads to Barcelona for a Weekend Break. Over the course of 3 days he tries incredible local food and drink and gets involved with local customs in a city where there always seems to be a party to join!

programme.title: Traveling with Denella S6 - "Little Rock"
programme.desc: In this episode, Denella visits Little Rock, Arkansas, Arkansas's capital city.

programme.title: Traveling with Denella S6 - "Boston"
programme.desc: In this episode, Denella visits Boston, Massachusetts.

programme.title: Traveling with Denella S6 - "Milwaukee"
programme.desc: Denella experiences Milwaukee\u2013where fresh meets fearless every day.

programme.title: The Coolest Places on Earth S1 - "Land of the Rising Sun"
programme.desc: Dive into the neon streets of Tokyo, Japan. Explore the sights and culture of the world's most populous city to see what makes it so magnetic.

programme.title: The Coolest Places on Earth S1 - "Aloha Hawaii"
programme.desc: Catch a wave in the Aloha State. Tour the four biggest islands, from the surfing mecca of the North Shore to the cinematic jungles of Kauai.

programme.title: The Coolest Places on Earth S1 - "Ten of the Coolest Places on Earth"
programme.desc: Look back at the most memorable destinations of the season, from the depths of the Great Barrier Reef to the top of the Empire State Building.

programme.title: Travel in Style S2 - "ITALY & FRANCE"
programme.desc: This time we visit Milan the home of fashion. In part two we are all at sea, well more on river to be truthful in beautiful Burgandy in the wine region of France.

programme.title: Travel in Style S2 - "CAPE TOWN & BLUE MOUNTAINS"
programme.desc: In the episode we visit the Mother City of South Africa \u2013 Cape Town. The second half of the show is based in the distinctive blue haze of the Blue Mountains, Australia.

programme.title: Travel in Style S2 - "BANGKOK & NEW YORK"
programme.desc: We visit floating Markets, Royal Palaces and the new spa and sauna of the Peninsula Hotel in Bangkok. Then it\u2019s off to the city that's so good they named it twice\u2026 New York!

programme.title: Big Little Footprints S1 - "Ranch Life - Texas"
programme.desc: Sometimes exploring the road less traveled gives you the biggest adventure. In this episode, we escape the city buzz and opt for a quieter life on a Texas ranch. Taking time to appreciate the beauty in history, animals and quality time as a family.

programme.title: Big Little Footprints S1 - "Luxury With Purpose - Belize"
programme.desc: Join us on an epic adventure to a remote private island in Belize. As we spend our days catching lobsters, diving the worldclass reef and enjoying coconuts straight from the tree. We also learn about how much our tourism dollars really count.

programme.title: Big Little Footprints S1 - "Daring Dive into Conservation - Fiji"
programme.desc: We travel to an island resort in Fiji known for it\u2019s daring shark encounters! To hear and see first hand the amazing conservation work they\u2019re doing. Along the way we meet the local school kids and learn about how they\u2019re helping protect the reef.

programme.title: Jet Set S1 - "Algarve V Istanbul"
programme.desc: Portugal\u2019s Algarve has long been a favorite holiday destination in Europe. Gill takes a boat ride along the regions famous sea cave coastline. While Richard enjoys a tour around the Turkish city of Istanbul, and visits the jewel in the cities crown.

programme.title: Jet Set S1 - "Toledo Spain V Provo (Turks & Caicos)"
programme.desc: Gill throws everything she\u2019s got into this episode in her Spanish safari from the countryside town of Toledo, seventy kilometers south of Madrid. Richard visits the tiny island of Providenciales, part of the Turks and Caicos Islands in the Caribbean.

programme.title: Jet Set S1 - "Lisbon V Parrot Cay (Turks & Caicos)"
programme.desc: In the penultimate episode Richard remains in the Turks and Caicos Islands, only this time he\u2019s visiting the exclusive island resort of Parrot Cay. While Gill\u2019s combining a city and beach break in the Portuguese capital of Lisbon.

programme.title: A Taste of Travel S4 - "Sorrento, Denarau"
programme.desc: Carolyne explores the gorgeous town of Sorrento, Italy. Scotty continues his trip in South Africa and samples some of the local delicacies. Lynton makes a splash in Denarau, Fiji. And Susannah wraps up her discovery tour of New York.

programme.title: A Taste of Travel S4 - "Florence, Los Angeles"
programme.desc: Lynton explores the iconic Coral Coast of Fiji. Carolyne visits the wonders of Florence. Scotty continues his journey through South Africa and Susannah discovers a slightly more sinister side of Los Angeles.

programme.title: A Taste of Travel S4 - "Athens, Tokyo"
programme.desc: Scotty wraps up his South African adventure with a visit to the Cape. Carolyne goes on a sojourn around Greece\u2019s capital, Athens. Susannah explores one of LA\u2019s unusual hot spots. Scotty ticks off one of his life-long bucket lists, Tokyo Japan.

programme.title: Journeys in India S1 - "The Land of Rudyard Kipling: Kanha & Bandhavgarh National Parks"
programme.desc: With classic tales as The Jungle Book to his credit, Rudyard Kipling brought India to life for many readers around the world. In this episode, Bill steps back into Kipling\u2019s wild world while exploring Kanha and Bandhavgarh National Parks.

programme.title: Journeys in India S1 - "Bangalore and Ooty"
programme.desc: Bangalore is a city with many names: the Garden City, the Pub City, the Fashion Capital the list goes on. Follow Bill as he journeys through this city of contrasts and touches on its many faces.

programme.title: Journeys in India S1 - "Mumbai & Goa"
programme.desc: Join us as we explore the Gateway to India\u2014Mumbai. From its early history, it\u2019s many foreign occupations to the hustle and bustle of today. Bill tells Mumbai\u2019s rich history is told through two of its most famous inhabitants, Gandhi and Kipling.

programme.title: Luxe Travels S1 - "Bali"
programme.desc: The Luxe Travels season starts off in the beautiful and highly popular tourism hotspot; Bali. The host, Liesel Hlista embarks on a mission to understand how the Balinese blend hospitality with luxury.

programme.title: Luxe Travels S1 - "Ireland"
programme.desc: An uncommon destination for a series that explores exotic tropical getaways. But this island nation has some of the most evocative landscapes that mother nature has to offer!

programme.title: Luxe Travels S1 - "Jamaica"
programme.desc: Easy island vibes, lots of amazing local rum, brilliant natural landscapes and those amazing beaches! Of course,Luxe Travels is in Jamaica! But in this episode, host Liesel Hlista shows you a different side of the Irie nation; away from the hordes of people unleashed via cruise liners!

programme.title: The Coolest Places on Earth S2 - "Even More of the Coolest Endurance Races"
programme.desc: Travel to the world's wildest endurance challenges, from the freezing Polar Circle tundra to Chile's most active volcano.

programme.title: The Coolest Places on Earth S2 - "Coolest Caves, Vistas, and Natural Wonders"
programme.desc: Climb into the planet's deepest caves, take in beautiful vistas, and witness dazzling natural phenomena across the globe.

programme.title: The Coolest Places on Earth S2 - "Coolest Buildings, Public Art, and Public Parks"
programme.desc: Tour the world's tallest buildings, view incredible public art installations, and explore Singapore's dazzling treetop parks.

programme.title: Around the World in 80 Tricks S1 - "South Korea - Traditional"
programme.desc: In this episode Bones is in South Korea, where he visits Taekwondo group, the K Tigers, a tarot card reader and reveals the secret to the perfect card shuffle.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S1 - "Racing a Million Devotees"
programme.desc: Jonathan gets the classic train experience acclimating to bizarre washroom customs and the diversity of society rolling down the tracks. Glory, salvation and madness ensue when the master of the universe emerges from his temple.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S1 - "Cruising the City of Joy"
programme.desc: Our host dives deep into the rich stew of colonial legacies and neighborhood traditions.

programme.title: A New Life in the Sun S1 - "Mediterranean Scuba"
programme.desc: A British family faces local resistance while opening a business in the Spanish desert. Scuba divers search for a century-old wreck. A French townhouse begins its transformation.

programme.title: A New Life in the Sun S1 - "The Boss"
programme.desc: An expat adjusts to working with her husband after 34 years of teaching. A scuba business considers relocating to the UK. Bar owners in Spain's desert face their busiest night.

programme.title: House Hunt S1 - "A Seller's Market"
programme.desc: Young professionals Martin & Helena face up to the complexities of the Christchurch housing market and South Aucklanders Shandel and Steven battle spiralling prices as they search for a family home.

programme.title: House Hunt S1 - "Rollercoaster Ride"
programme.desc: Blenheim schoolteachers Joanna and Chris begin a rollercoaster ride to home ownership and in South Auckland, locals Shandel and Steven take on the investors in their quest to secure a family home.

programme.title: Roads Unknown India S1 - "The Journey Begins"
programme.desc: Overcoming illness and the chaos of bustling Chennai city traffic, Jess rides with a diverse group through vibrant coastal towns, before venturing inland toward the mountains and the sacred town of Palani.

programme.title: The Streets S1 - "Houston"
programme.desc: Jamie Hancock was raised in Houston\u2019s South Park area, a place notorious for gang violence, but also where hip hop artists created a new sound. Today, a new positive message is being created by people like Jamie through music.

programme.title: Piri’s Tiki Tour S6 - "Te Matau-a-Māui"
programme.desc: Piri and ex M\u0101ori All Black Shannon Paku are in Te Matau-a-M\u0101ui (Hawkes Bay). They\u2019re hosted by Rob Beard of Beard Brothers Sausages, targeting Koura and Gurnard. They also visit Piri\u2019s old stomping grounds of Te Aute College with ex-classmate Tautoko Ratu.

programme.title: Piri’s Tiki Tour S6 - "Whakatāne"
programme.desc: Piri and ex Crusader Tu Umaga-Marshall are in Whakatane. Hosted by Henare Ruru and Henare Rangitaawa of The Dive Squad, they target Haku (Kingfish), give tips and tricks to the Taneatua and Paroa Rugby Clubs and go on a Boar hunt with Troy Petersen.

programme.title: Piri’s Tiki Tour S6 - "Waikawa"
programme.desc: Piri and ex Warrior Paul Whatuira are in Waikawa (Picton), diving and gathering kai for the local Kaumatua, trying for a day time Tuna (Eel) with Shannon\u2019s son Malone and having a run around at the Motueka Rugby Club.

programme.title: Piri’s Tiki Tour S3 - "Hawkes Bay"
programme.desc: Padre takes Piri to the river mouth fishing for kahawai. Plus we follow the dugs in search of wild pigs.

programme.title: The Streets S1 - "Las Vegas"
programme.desc: Las Vegas is home to a hot rod car club community which over the decades has been connected to the rise of rockabilly music. Through Luke Metz and his band, Shanda & The Howlers, we learn how this bond between fashion, music and cars was created.

programme.title: The Armchair Adventurer S1 - "Royalty in Robertson"
programme.desc: While Xander and his team experience the lush, green valleys and incredible vineyards in Robertson, Adam learns a tough lesson about not only surviving, but thriving.

programme.title: The Armchair Adventurer S1 - "Historical Swellendam"
programme.desc: While Xavier works with a professional South African stunt performer to go mountain biking and kayaking, Adam endeavors to complete a stunt of his own.

programme.title: The Armchair Adventurer S1 - "On the Edge in Gans Bay"
programme.desc: While Xander travels to the fishing town of Gansbaai to experience the joys, and horrors, of the sea, Adam experiences a few frights of his own back at home.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S2 - "Barentsburg"
programme.desc: Local Exploring on the edge of the world as Josh is on the artic Svalbard archipelago to explore in and around Barentsburg and the Arctic Ocean.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S2 - "Tirana"
programme.desc: From Tirana, capital of old Soviet satellite Albania, Josh starts another local adventure filled with bunkers, a hidden hospital and diving in a pirate\u2019s cave.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S2 - "Lüderitz"
programme.desc: Epic Exploring is going local again as Cody adventures in L\u00FCderitz, Namibia going off the beaten path, through the desert and on to the ghost town of Pamona.

programme.title: Epic Trails S2 - "Canada’s Sunshine Coast, BC"
programme.desc: Eric Hanson heads to British Columbia\u2019s beautiful Sunshine Coast, to explore the 112-mile long Sunshine Coast Trail and to test his nerves at the Coast Gravity Downhill Mountain Bike Park.

programme.title: Epic Trails S2 - "Peak District & Derbyshire"
programme.desc: Eric Hanson heads to the Peak District in England, to tackle the 268-mile Pennine Way\u2014Britain\u2019s oldest and most challenging National Trail.

programme.title: Epic Trails S2 - "Juneau, Alaska"
programme.desc: Eric Hanson heads deep into the backcountry to explore the mountains, glaciers and wildlife around Alaska\u2019s capital city of Juneau.

programme.title: Love On The Rocks S1 - "Marriage Highs"
programme.desc: Tayler and Jason reconnect during a romantic stay in Lake Tahoe, but Jason struggles keeping his cool while off roading the Rubicon Trail. Are Jason's high expectations too? And will these expectations shut them down on their next climb, Mt Whitney?

programme.title: Love On The Rocks S1 - "Alpenglow"
programme.desc: Jason and Tayler attempt to summit the highest peak in the continental US, Mt Whitney. However, during their time on ascent they run into some unexpected surprises that leave this mountain attempt one they will never forget.

programme.title: Love On The Rocks S1 - "One More Round"
programme.desc: A relaxing trip to Orcas Island takes a turn for the worst when plans begin to fall through; including the ferry ride back to the mainland. This mishap may leave them stranded for longer than expected, putting their final summit attempt at risk.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S1 - "Delhi to Manali"
programme.desc: On the verge of an epic roadtrip, Jonathan visits the shrine of the motorcycle God for providence and sidetracks to combat the all-woman unit of the Delhi police.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S1 - "Ladakh, the Mountain Adventure"
programme.desc: Jonathan embarks on a two wheeled journey over the highest roads in the world, stopping in remote monasteries to learn the secrets of Buddhism\u2019s warrior demons and track down a secreted manuscript rumored to explain the lost years of Jesus.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S6 - "Thailand: World War II Secrets"
programme.desc: Jonathan explores hidden bunkers, stashed warplanes, and forgotten memorials to uncover Thailand's suppressed World War II history.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S6 - "Indonesia: The Java Coffee Quest"
programme.desc: Jonathan traces Java's colonial coffee roots, explores mysterious temples, and joins the Jakarta Fire Department for a trial by fire.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S6 - "Indonesia to India: Capitals and Currents"
programme.desc: Jonathan examines Indonesia's massive capital relocation before following a spiritual quest centered on sacred water all the way to India.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S6 - "India: Secrets of the Deep South"
programme.desc: Venture off the beaten path into southern India as Jonathan investigates the origins of mysterious temples and untold regional histories.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S6 - "India: Chasing the Ramayana"
programme.desc: Riding a Royal Enfield, Jonathan retraces the epic Ramayana through crocodile habitats and sunken temples to the edge of the subcontinent.

programme.title: 7 Days S1 - "Day 1"
programme.desc: Kevin travels to Switzerland and has 24 hours to go from Zurich to the Swiss mountains, while Jalou finds an exciting way to go from Cannes to Corsica.

programme.title: 7 Days S1 - "Day 2"
programme.desc: Jalou has 24 hours to get from Barcelona to Tarragona where she conquers the Catalonian mountains with her mountain bike. Kevin tries to beat her in Slovenia.

programme.title: 7 Days S1 - "Day 3"
programme.desc: Kevin leaves civilization behind in Suriname, while thousands of kilometers away, Jalou has to go literally through the trees in an Australian forest.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent S1 - "Bucket List"
programme.desc: Mike\u2019s friend invites him to an Indian wedding & tells him about his uncle who is looking for a luxury condo close to the airport. This client is looking for an investment property & a place for him to live when visiting.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent S1 - "Right Choice"
programme.desc: Daryl & Jin play some golf to discuss a potential listing she has found & Mike aids Inez in purchasing a new vehicle. Daryl\u2019s client has older children with their own families now so they are looking for a home with lots of land & nature.

programme.title: Khanh Ong's Wild Food S1 - "Cairns, QLD"
programme.desc: Chef Khanh Ong travels to Cairns, Australia where he embarks on an adventure to the rainforests of Mission Beach. Learning from locals, he learns how to hunt mud crabs with a spear on the traditional fishing grounds of the Kuku Yalanji people.

programme.title: Khanh Ong's Wild Food S1 - "Eyre Peninsula, SA"
